description: Bounded observation-identity audit for adjacent MRT archive overlap candidates.
claim_boundaries: A base-row fingerprint match is not sufficient to delete a routing observation.
Matching peer identity is an archive-overlap duplicate candidate, not automatic proof that two protocol messages are identical.
Distinct peer identities sharing one base fingerprint are legitimate separate observations unless stronger evidence proves otherwise.
This audit does not create attack or benign truth.
This audit does not modify the 10-day Parquet materialization, foreground policy, evidence state, or learning layer.
